text.en:
I also amend Administrative Order No. 64 dated Sep-
tember 27, 1954, organizing the Asian Neighbor Relations
Commission, by changing the designation of Mr. Modesto
Farolan from Executive Vice-Chairman to Vice-Chairman
designating Dr. Juan O. Orendain as Executive Secretary;
and including Mr. Oscar Arellano as an additional member
of said Commission.
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of January,
in the vear of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-five,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the ninth.
RAMON MAGSAYSAY
President of the Philippines
By the President:
FRED RUIZ CASTRO
Executive Secretary
